thread:
Kei: Quick report: our Go sample app shows token duplication when we cancel and immediately retry the generator. Minimal repro attached. Anyone have a recommended pattern?

Romy: Can you paste the simplest snippet?

Kei: Sure:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(req.Context(), 150*time.Millisecond)
defer cancel()
it, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return "", err }
for tok := range it.Stream() { out += tok }
// sometimes blocks or returns duped fragments
return it.Result(), nil
```

Felix: Two likely causes: (1) mid-handshake auth refresh or network RST leaves internal goroutines waiting so Result() blocks; (2) OS/proxy can replay buffered bytes onto the next socket causing duplicate tokens.

Marin: Workarounds we've used: (A) always create a fresh Generator/transport for retries (safe, more overhead); (B) spawn a small goroutine to forward Stream() to a channel and select on ctx.Done(), calling a best-effort it.Close() if canceled.

Kei: Can you paste the small non-blocking consume helper?

Marin: Compact pattern:
```go
func drainOrAbort(ctx context.Context, it sdk.Iterator) (string, error) {
  ch := make(chan string)
  done := make(chan struct{})
  go func(){ for t := range it.Stream() { ch <- t }; close(done) }()
  var out string
  for {
    select {
    case <-ctx.Done():
      _ = it.Close(context.Background())
      return "", ctx.Err()
    case t := <-ch:
      out += t
    case <-done:
      return it.Result(), nil
    }
  }
}
```

Felix: SDK action items we discussed earlier: add Iterator.Close(ctx), add ResultWithContext(ctx) that accepts a ctx, and expose a Transport option to force reset between retries. That lets users choose safety vs latency.

Kei: I'll add the helper to the quickstart and file an issue for iterator.Close. Can someone volunteer to review a small PR with a sample + e2e that fuzzes cancels mid-handshake?

Romy: I can review. Also add a note about preferring transport-level token rotation to avoid mid-handshake 401 races.

CI-bot: Issue created: #5577 "go-sdk: streaming duplicate tokens and blocking Result() when canceled mid-handshake". PR pending: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/333 (ci: flaky on darwin).

Kei: Thanks all ":+1:" I'll open the PR tomorrow and link the test harness. Closing this thread for now.
